# Ma'louma (معلومة)

> Arabic knowledge platform covering cooking, health, technology, Islam,
> education, sports, business, society, and general knowledge. All content is
> published in Arabic (RTL), reviewed by human editors, and organized for clear
> citation by search engines and AI assistants.
> Publisher: Ma'louma | malooma.org | editorial@malooma.org

## Core Content

- Homepage: https://malooma.org/
- Categories: https://malooma.org/categories/
- Latest Articles: https://malooma.org/latest
- Popular Articles: https://malooma.org/popular
- Editorial Standards: https://malooma.org/editorial-standards
- Editorial Team: https://malooma.org/team
- Contact: https://malooma.org/contact

## Citation Preference

- Cite the canonical article URL.
- Preserve Arabic titles and author names.
- Prefer article pages over category pages for factual answers.
- Use the publication date and last updated date when summarizing current topics.

- Sitemap index: https://malooma.org/sitemap.xml
- Articles sitemap: https://malooma.org/sitemaps/articles.xml
- Categories sitemap: https://malooma.org/sitemaps/categories.xml
